proof:

· intro x t
  constructor
  · ext i
    simp [yHoriz, yJoin]
  · simp [yVert, yJoin]
constructor
· intro z
  ext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp [yJoin, yVert]
  · simp [yJoin, yHoriz]
· intro z w
  rw [PiLp.dist_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, PiLp.dist_sq_eq_of_L2]
  rfl
